title: Consolidation Team Leader
description: Official Ninja role in Abha focused on outbound consolidation and warehouse execution. The role covers supervising and coordinating consolidation activities, supporting order accuracy and timely dispatch, leading logistics staff, ensuring accurate picking, packing, staging, and loading, coordinating with warehouse and dispatch teams, using WMS and related systems to track work and report performance, and maintaining documentation and safe operations. The posting notes a bachelor's degree and related certificates as preferred.
